answer: Cabinet-Contest Admission Slots.** Each identity slot is a physical cabinet wired to the network, holding a sealed random challenge chip; registration requires solving the chip's response, which only exists inside that cabinet, so one operator must buy and house one unit per identity. A canyon of shipping lead times and a serialized supply chain makes bulk duplication slow and traceable. Think of each cabinet as a distinct orchard tree you must plant and tend before harvest.
